text:
lin: Quick heads-up 4e2 I'm drafting a short migration section for ScalePolicy v2 (replace tenant_label -> tenant_selector). Plan: one JSON canonical example, small Python SDK + Go CLI snippets, and a tiny Terragrunt mapping. Opening draft PR in a few minutes.

sora: Nice. Can you also add a short troubleshooting subsection for why an isolation annotation might not map to reserved_pool (most common cause: missing tenant tag on the pool)? Ops trip over that.

lin: Good point. I'll include an ops checklist and a one-line runbook command to map tenants to pools.

mike: For docs tone: let's avoid repeating the old YAML examples. Keep V2 examples JSON-first and include a short diff example showing how to convert.

anya: Please include a Python snippet (requests + SDK) since a few customers use the SDK in py. Example should show ApplyScalePolicy + handling 409 (conflict) when a rollout is in progress.

lin: Draft examples I'm planning:
```json
{
  "scalePolicy": {
    "minReplicas": 2,
    "maxReplicas": 10,
    "cooldownSeconds": 120,
    "burstPolicy": "reserve_then_best_effort",
    "tenantSelector": {"matchLabels": {"team": "billing"}},
    "isolation": "high"
  }
}
```

lin: Python SDK snippet:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, ScalePolicy
client = RedwoodClient(os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
policy = ScalePolicy(min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, cooldown_seconds=120)
try:
    client.apply_scale_policy('tenant-billing', policy)
except ConflictError:
    print('Rollout in progress; will retry')
```

lin: Go CLI equivalent to include: `redwoodctl scale apply --selector 'team=billing' --min 2 --max 10 --cooldown 120 --isolation high`

mike: Also add a short bullet about SLAs: Dedicated preemption is "best-effort" by default; if customer requires contractual non-preemption they must request hardened isolation + reserved_pool assignment. Link to SLA annex.

anya: For the Terragrunt snippet, show how to map old tenant_label var -> tenant_selector label set. Keep it tiny.

lin: Will do. Another tiny ask: add a short table for cooldown defaults (chat 60s, http-webhook 120s, batch 300s). We'll point to perf benchmarks.

sora: Reviewer volunteers: I'll review examples and ops checklist. @mike can you glance at SLA sentence for legal friendly wording?

mike: Yup, I can.

deploy-bot: Draft PR created by lin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 4dd labels: docs,dedicated,scalepolicy

lin: PR posted. Tagging reviewers. I'll also prepare a short conversion script for customers that bulk-updated tenant_label -> tenant_selector.

anya: One small add: include the `redwoodctl` dry-run flag in the CLI example so teams can validate without touching live config. e.g. `--dry-run`.

lin: Good call 44d will add.

sora: After merge, can we backport a short note to the troubleshooting section in the oncall handbook? It's useful during pager nights.

lin: Yep, I'll open a backport PR after this merges.

mike: Looks good. If ops confirm the reserved_pool mapping note, we can ship.

lin: Thanks all 680 I'll push an update with the dry-run flag and the Terragrunt sample in the next 10m.

deploy-bot: lin merged pull request 834 into main 44b closed by lin

lin: Backport PR opened for handbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/836 4c4

anya: Thanks team. Small but helpful change.
